the performance of machine learning based approaches can be further improved by using more features.

the performance of the models is highly dependent on the quality of the training data.
The main takeaway from our work is that

a simple machine learning model, trained with a relatively small amount of data and using a simple feature set, can perform well in the tasks of algorithmically generated domain detection and malware family classification.
a simple machine learning model, trained with a large amount of labeled data, can outperform a more complicated model, trained with less labeled data, in a domain detection task.
the performance of the best performing machine learning based approach is not significantly worse than that of a rule-based approach.
